caption: The drawing depicts three squirrels with yellow and pink fur, positioned on a brown and yellow tree branch. Two of the squirrels are fully visible, one sitting upright with its bushy tail arched behind and holding what appears to be a nut or food item, while the other is lying down facing the upright squirrel. The third squirrel is partially visible on the left side of the composition, with just its head, upper body, and tail shown. The tree has multiple branches with clusters of dark green and yellow foliage. The background is a teal color and there is green grass with dark, spiky lines at the base of the tree. The composition uses bold outlines and a limited palette of pink, yellow, green, teal, and brown tones throughout. The drawing occupies an off-white background with a visible border around the main image area.
title: Bandbox Design - Squirrels
